offices.title: Selectboard Member
offices.org_name: Town of St. Johnsbury Select Board

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 151 (Town of St. Johnsbury): sec. 201(a) provides for a five-member Select Board elected on staggered terms (three three-year seats and two one-year seats)

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Frank Empsall (Chair), Ellen Burt (Vice Chair), Brendan Hughes, Steven Isham, and Dennis Smith; the 2025 report's board predates the March 2026 election, so the directory governs the board's current composition

offices.title: Town Clerk
offices.org_name: Town of St. Johnsbury Town Clerk

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 151 (Town of St. Johnsbury): sec. 201(a) provides for an elected Town Clerk on a three-year term

Town of St. Johnsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'ELECTED OFFICIALS' and 'APPOINTED OFFICIALS' tables in the town officers section (officers with term-expiry years), published in the town's document center: Town Clerk Stacy Jewell, term to 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Stacy Jewell as St. Johnsbury's Town Clerk

offices.title: Town Treasurer
offices.org_name: Town of St. Johnsbury Town Treasurer

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 151 (Town of St. Johnsbury): sec. 201(a) provides for an elected Town Treasurer on a three-year term

Town of St. Johnsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'ELECTED OFFICIALS' and 'APPOINTED OFFICIALS' tables in the town officers section (officers with term-expiry years), published in the town's document center: Town Treasurer Stacy Jewell, term to 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Stacy Jewell as St. Johnsbury's Town Treasurer

offices.title: Town Moderator
offices.org_name: Town of St. Johnsbury Town Moderator

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 151 (Town of St. Johnsbury): sec. 201(a) lists the Moderator among the town's elective officers on a three-year term, and provides that the Moderator is appointed instead if the town so votes

Town of St. Johnsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'ELECTED OFFICIALS' and 'APPOINTED OFFICIALS' tables in the town officers section (officers with term-expiry years), published in the town's document center: the report files Moderator David Reynolds under APPOINTED OFFICIALS, not among the elected officials, so he is seated as an appointee under the charter's town-vote option

offices.title: Cemetery Commissioner
offices.org_name: Town of St. Johnsbury Cemetery Commissioners

sources.note: Town of St. Johnsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'ELECTED OFFICIALS' and 'APPOINTED OFFICIALS' tables in the town officers section (officers with term-expiry years), published in the town's document center: the report's ELECTED OFFICIALS table lists three Cemetery Commissioners -- Lauren Jarvi (term to 2027), Tim Clouatre (to 2026), and Bryan LeBlanc (to 2028). Chapter 151 neither creates the office nor assigns its appointment, so cemetery commissions under 18 V.S.A. sec. 5373 and the town's continuing elected practice govern (flagged on issue #163)

Town of St. Johnsbury, Cemetery Commission minutes of June 11, 2026 (town document center): all three commissioners -- Bryan LeBlanc, Tim Clouatre, and Lauren Jarvi (her surname carries a diacritic in the minutes, Järvi) -- are in attendance and serving after the March 2026 meeting, which carries Clouatre past his printed 2026 term expiry

offices.org_name: Town of St. Johnsbury Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen St. Johnsbury justices of the peace: Brent Abare, Durward Ellis, Chase Empsall, Frank Empsall, Stephanie Churchill, Diane Holmes, Robert Holmes, William Y. Hyde, Loraine Janowski, Tristan Lemieux, Kevin Oddy, Jane Pompeo, Heather Whitemore, Lynn Wurzburg, and Janssen Willhoit

Town of St. Johnsbury, 2025 Annual Report, 'ELECTED OFFICIALS' and 'APPOINTED OFFICIALS' tables in the town officers section (officers with term-expiry years), published in the town's document center: the report's justice of the peace list matches the certified listing name for name
